what: listening verdicts for character voice pairs

verdicts.notes: Sometimes the little gurl sounds like a little girl but not always
thought that I hadn’t seen you … like the highs of it were breaking like the character’s voice was cracking it was very bad
thought that I hadn’t seen you in a ….. same as the last one with the cracking voice very unpleasant

caveat: 3 of 10 pairs, one rater, not blinded. Two of the three sit far above the ~1.95 semitone JND and are the easy cases; the informative one is girl_satella at 0.9 semitones.
what_the_notes_found_that_the_metric_doe: Two of three notes report audible artifacts - a voice 'cracking'/'breaking on the highs', 'very bad', 'very unpleasant'. Both concern the same single clip, ab_test_runtime/chapter_audio/2702aec220b0.wav (speaker Subaru, category lora), which appeared in both rated pairs. Distinctiveness is orthogonal to this: both pairs were scored clearly_different and the human agreed. A separation goal can be MET while the audio is unpleasant.

followup_probe.question: does the cracking follow high pitch, or was it one bad render?
followup_probe.fact: 2702aec220b0 has the highest median f0 of Subaru's 15 clips, 386.5 Hz against the character's own 264.8 Hz median, about 7 semitones above centre
followup_probe.result: The clean low-pitch control scored 5 and the flagged high-pitch clip scored 1, but the intermediate clips were non-monotonic (1, 2, 4). Spearman rho is -0.60 for pitch versus quality at n=5: suggestive, not enough to claim pitch alone causes the damage.

cleanliness.verdict: all three Satella clips were rated bad; the four non-Satella clips averaged 4.5/5

second_listening_round.interpretation: The distinctiveness question passed, while Satella exposed a separate audible-quality failure that the identity and pitch metrics do not detect. One non-Satella clip was also noted as reverberant.

discarded_instrument: A frame-to-frame f0 jump rate (>6 semitones) was computed as a cracking proxy and DISCARDED before use: the NARRATOR, whose audio drew no complaint, scores 10.4-17.8% against the flagged clip's 15.9%. It measures YIN octave errors, not audible cracking. Recorded so it is not rebuilt.
